newsitem.title: USA: Lucent gets $1 billion equipment contract from Bell Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: Lucent gets $1 billion equipment contract from Bell Atlantic.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc. said Thursday it will sell up to $1.0 billion of switching equipment, software, and other products to Bell Atlantic Corp.

Lucent, the telecommunications equipment maker, which was spun off last year from AT&T Corp., said the five-year agreement also includes the conversion of a significant portion of Bell Atlantic's network from analogue to digital, and the switch interfaces needed to provide more sophisticated digital-based services.

The company said its 5ESS-2000 switch and AnyMedia platform have the ability to provide voice, data, wireless and video services including local, long-distance and international gateway service on a single switch.
Lucent's stock was off 25 cents at $53 on the New York Stock Exchange.
